questions.question: Review the English wordplay: Krugloyed is retained as the creature’s name, glossed as round-eater, and its sound resemblance to Russian krugloye d is explained in Notes. Decide whether an independent English pun would work better.

localizations.source: Review the English wordplay: Krugloyed is retained as the creature’s name, glossed as round-eater, and its sound resemblance to Russian krugloye d is explained in Notes. Decide whether an independent English pun would work better.
localizations.ru: Проверить английскую адаптацию «круглоеда»: выдуманное имя оставлено как Krugloyed, раскрыто через round-eater, а созвучие krugloye d объяснено в EN-примечании. Решить, нужен ли более самостоятельный английский каламбур.

questions.resolution: The Krugloyed adaptation is accepted: the name is retained, while round-eater and the resemblance to krugloye d are explained in Notes without inventing an English homonym.
